name: The Teacup Ride on a Giant Wave
description: A whimsical, giant ocean wave curling perfectly into the shape of a teacup, with a tiny, delicate porcelain teacup boat sailing through the swirling water.
prompt: A surreal, whimsical ocean scene where a giant, curling wave forms the shape of a massive teacup. Inside this liquid teacup, a tiny, delicate porcelain teacup acts as a boat, sailing smoothly on the swirling water. The sky is a soft, dreamy pastel color, and the water has a silky, elegant texture. Playful, magical, and highly creative.
caption: Sailing through the giant teacup of the sea, where the ocean waves are gentle and playful. 🍵🌊
